package engine

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"

	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/checks/model"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/contracts"
	"github.com/lurkshark/fireweed/packages/project"
)

func moduleItems(module project.Module) ([]contracts.Item, error) {
	section, _ := contracts.Section(module.Document.Body, "Specs")
	return contracts.ParseItems(section)
}

func Evaluate(ctx context.Context, request model.HookRequest) (model.Report, error) {
	var report model.Report
	var module *project.Module
	for i := range request.Snapshot.Modules {
		if request.Snapshot.Modules[i].Name == request.Module {
			module = &request.Snapshot.Modules[i]
			break
		}
	}
	if module == nil {
		return report, coded("U02", "unknown module %q", request.Module)
	}
	items, err := moduleItems(*module)
	if err != nil {
		code := "C03"
		if discovered, _, ok := contracts.ErrorCode(err); ok && (discovered == "C03" || discovered == "C05") {
			code = discovered
		} else if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "duplicate") {
			code = "C05"
		}
		return report, coded(code, "%v", err)
	}
	command := hook(request.Snapshot.Config, "eval")
	if v := hook(module.Document.Frontmatter, "eval"); v != nil {
		command = v
	}
	if command == nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "missing eval hook for %s", module.Name)
	}
	f, err := os.CreateTemp("", "fireweed-junit-*.xml")
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "create JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	path := f.Name()
	_ = f.Close()
	_ = os.Remove(path)
	defer os.Remove(path)
	args, err := commandTemplate(command, map[string]string{"module": module.Name, "module_dir": module.Dir, "report": path})
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "%v", err)
	}
	result := runProcess(ctx, args, request.Snapshot.Root, request.Bin, request.Timeout)
	report.Stdout, report.Stderr, report.HookExit = result.stdout, result.stderr, result.exit
	if result.err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "run hook: %v", result.err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "read JUnit report: %v", err)
	}
	parsed, err := ParseJUnit(data, items)
	if err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	parsed.Stdout, parsed.Stderr, parsed.HookExit = result.stdout, result.stderr, result.exit
	failing := false
	for _, c := range parsed.Cases {
		if c.Result == "fail" {
			failing = true
			break
		}
	}
	if (result.exit == 0) == failing {
		return parsed, coded("C11", "eval hook exit %d disagrees with JUnit failures", result.exit)
	}
	return parsed, nil
}

func boundaryHookName(module *project.Module) string {
	if module == nil {
		return "global boundaries hook"
	}
	return module.Name + " boundaries hook"
}

func Boundaries(ctx context.Context, request model.BoundaryRequest) ([]project.Diagnostic, error) {
	var diags []project.Diagnostic
	var failures []error
	baseline := map[string]bool{}
	if data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(request.Snapshot.Root, ".fireweed", "boundaries-baseline")); err == nil {
		for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
			baseline[line] = true
		}
	}
	global := hook(request.Snapshot.Config, "boundaries")
	groups := []struct {
		module  *project.Module
		command any
	}{}
	if global != nil {
		groups = append(groups, struct {
			module  *project.Module
			command any
		}{nil, global})
	}
	for i := range request.Snapshot.Modules {
		m := &request.Snapshot.Modules[i]
		reason := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]))
		if reason != "" {
			diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X03", Message: m.Name + ": boundaries opt out: " + reason, Warning: true})
		}
		override := hook(m.Document.Frontmatter, "boundaries")
		if override != nil {
			groups = append(groups, struct {
				module  *project.Module
				command any
			}{m, override})
		}
		if global == nil && override == nil {
			if len(m.Zones.Disposable) > 0 && reason == "" {
				d := project.Diagnostic{Code: "X02", Message: m.Name + ": missing boundaries hook"}
				diags = append(diags, d)
				failures = append(failures, errors.New(d.Message))
			} else {
				diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X04", Message: m.Name + ": no boundary enforcement required", Warning: true})
			}
		}
	}
	if len(groups) == 0 && len(request.Snapshot.Modules) == 0 {
		diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X04", Message: "no boundary enforcement required", Warning: true})
	}
	for _, g := range groups {
		name := boundaryHookName(g.module)
		values := map[string]string{}
		if g.module != nil {
			values["module"] = g.module.Name
			values["module_dir"] = g.module.Dir
		}
		args, err := commandTemplate(g.command, values)
		if err != nil {
			diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X02", Message: name + ": " + err.Error()})
			failures = append(failures, err)
			continue
		}
		result := runProcess(ctx, args, request.Snapshot.Root, request.Bin, request.Timeout)
		if result.err != nil {
			diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X02", Message: name + ": " + result.err.Error()})
			failures = append(failures, result.err)
			continue
		}
		for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(result.stdout+"\n"+result.stderr, "\n"), "\n") {
			if line == "" || baseline[line] {
				continue
			}
			attributed := false
			for _, m := range request.Snapshot.Modules {
				if !strings.HasPrefix(line, m.Name+":") {
					continue
				}
				attributed = true
				reason := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(m.Document.Frontmatter["boundaries_opt_out"]))
				if reason == "" {
					diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X01", Message: line, Path: m.Dir})
					failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("%s", line))
				}
				break
			}
			if !attributed {
				diags = append(diags, project.Diagnostic{Code: "X01", Message: line})
				failures = append(failures, fmt.Errorf("%s", line))
			}
		}
	}
	return diags, errors.Join(failures...)
}

package engine

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

func coded(code, format string, args ...any) error {
	return fmt.Errorf("%s: %s", code, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
}

func object(v any) map[string]any {
	switch m := v.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		return m
	case map[any]any:
		r := map[string]any{}
		for k, v := range m {
			if s, ok := k.(string); ok {
				r[s] = v
			}
		}
		return r
	}
	return nil
}

func stringValue(v any) string { s, _ := v.(string); return s }
func stringsValue(v any) []string {
	switch a := v.(type) {
	case []string:
		return a
	case []any:
		r := make([]string, 0, len(a))
		for _, v := range a {
			if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
				r = append(r, s)
			}
		}
		return r
	}
	return nil
}

func hook(config map[string]any, name string) any { return object(config["hooks"])[name] }

var placeholder = regexp.MustCompile(`\{(module|module_dir|report|prompt|prompt_file|git_common_dir)\}`)

func quote(s string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(s, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }
func expand(s string, values map[string]string, shell bool) string {
	return placeholder.ReplaceAllStringFunc(s, func(match string) string {
		v, ok := values[match[1:len(match)-1]]
		if !ok {
			return match
		}
		if shell {
			return quote(v)
		}
		return v
	})
}

func commandTemplate(v any, values map[string]string) ([]string, error) {
	switch c := v.(type) {
	case string:
		if strings.TrimSpace(c) == "" {
			return nil, errors.New("empty hook command")
		}
		return []string{"sh", "-c", expand(c, values, true)}, nil
	case []string:
		if len(c) == 0 {
			return nil, errors.New("empty hook argv")
		}
		r := make([]string, len(c))
		for i, s := range c {
			r[i] = expand(s, values, false)
		}
		return r, nil
	case []any:
		if len(c) == 0 {
			return nil, errors.New("empty hook argv")
		}
		r := make([]string, len(c))
		for i, v := range c {
			s, ok := v.(string)
			if !ok {
				return nil, errors.New("hook argv contains non-string")
			}
			r[i] = expand(s, values, false)
		}
		return r, nil
	default:
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid hook command %T", v)
	}
}

type processResult struct {
	stdout, stderr string
	exit           int
	err            error
}

func runProcess(ctx context.Context, args []string, dir, bin string, timeout time.Duration) processResult {
	if timeout <= 0 {
		timeout = 3 * time.Minute
	}
	cctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
	defer cancel()
	cmd := exec.Command(args[0], args[1:]...)
	cmd.Dir = dir
	cmd.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true}
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "FIREWEED_BIN="+bin)
	var out, errout bytes.Buffer
	cmd.Stdout, cmd.Stderr = &out, &errout
	if err := cmd.Start(); err != nil {
		return processResult{err: err}
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { done <- cmd.Wait() }()
	var err error
	select {
	case err = <-done:
	case <-cctx.Done():
		_ = syscall.Kill(-cmd.Process.Pid, syscall.SIGKILL)
		<-done
		err = cctx.Err()
	}
	r := processResult{stdout: out.String(), stderr: errout.String(), err: err}
	if e := new(exec.ExitError); errors.As(err, &e) {
		r.exit = e.ExitCode()
		r.err = nil
	}
	return r
}

func abs(root, path string) string {
	if filepath.IsAbs(path) {
		return path
	}
	return filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(path))
}

	Time      string        `xml:"time,attr"`
	Failures  []junitDetail `xml:"failure"`
	Errors    []junitDetail `xml:"error"`
	Skipped   []struct{}    `xml:"skipped"`
}
type junitDetail struct {
	Message string `xml:"message,attr"`
	Body    string `xml:",chardata"`
}

var idToken = func() *strings.Replacer { return strings.NewReplacer("_", "-", ".", "-") }()
var specLike = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)[a-z][a-z0-9]*[-_]?[0-9]{3,}`)

func ParseJUnit(data []byte, specs []contracts.Item) (model.Report, error) {
	var report model.Report
	d := xml.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
	first, err := d.Token()
	if err != nil {
		return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", err)
	}
	for {
		if _, ok := first.(xml.CharData); !ok {
			break
		}
		first, err = d.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", err)
		}
	}
	root, ok := first.(xml.StartElement)
	if !ok {
		return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: invalid XML root")
	}
	if root.Name.Local != "testsuite" && root.Name.Local != "testsuites" {
		return report, coded("C11", "invalid JUnit root %q", root.Name.Local)
	}
	known := map[string]bool{}
	for _, s := range specs {
		known[strings.ToUpper(s.ID)] = true
	}
	for {
		tok, e := d.Token()
		if e == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if e != nil {
			return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", e)
		}
		start, ok := tok.(xml.StartElement)
		if !ok || start.Name.Local != "testcase" {
			continue
		}
		var raw junitCase
		if e := d.DecodeElement(&raw, &start); e != nil {
			return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit: %v", e)
		}
		c := model.Case{Name: raw.Name, Classname: raw.Classname, Result: "pass"}
		if raw.Time != "" {
			c.Seconds, e = strconv.ParseFloat(raw.Time, 64)
			if e != nil {
				return report, coded("C11", "parse JUnit time: %v", e)
			}
		}
		for _, spec := range specs {
			if contracts.MatchesID(spec.ID, c.Name, c.Classname) {
				c.IDs = append(c.IDs, spec.ID)
			}
		}
		if len(c.IDs) == 0 {
			// Report an explicit unknown spec token when one is present.
			for _, field := range []string{c.Name, c.Classname} {
				for _, word := range specLike.FindAllString(field, -1) {
					candidate := strings.ToUpper(idToken.Replace(word))
					for prefix := range known {
						if i := strings.Index(prefix, "-"); i > 0 && strings.HasPrefix(candidate, prefix[:i]) && candidate != prefix && len(candidate) > i+1 {
							return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, word)
						}
					}
					if strings.ContainsAny(word, "-_") {
						return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q references unknown spec ID %q", c.Name, word)
					}
				}
			}
			return report, coded("C11", "testcase %q has no known spec ID", c.Name)
		}
		if len(raw.Failures)+len(raw.Errors) > 0 {
			c.Result = "fail"
			var parts []string
			for _, detail := range append(raw.Failures, raw.Errors...) {
				if s := strings.TrimSpace(detail.Message); s != "" {
					parts = append(parts, s)
				}
				if s := strings.TrimSpace(detail.Body); s != "" {
					parts = append(parts, s)
				}
			}
			c.Failure = strings.Join(parts, "\n")
		} else if len(raw.Skipped) > 0 {
			c.Result = "skip"
		}
		report.Cases = append(report.Cases, c)
		report.Seconds += c.Seconds
	}
	return report, nil
}

func exempt(tag string) bool {
	tag = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(tag))
	return strings.HasPrefix(tag, "review") || strings.HasPrefix(tag, "quarantine")
}
func hasID(ids []string, id string) bool {
	for _, v := range ids {
		if v == id {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func RequireCoverage(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
	for _, s := range specs {
		if exempt(s.Tag) {
			continue
		}
		found := false
		for _, c := range report.Cases {
			if c.Result != "skip" && hasID(c.IDs, s.ID) {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return coded("C10", "no coverage for %s", s.ID)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func RequireFailFirst(report model.Report, ids, already []string) error {
	for _, id := range ids {
		if hasID(already, id) {
			continue
		}
		found := false
		for _, c := range report.Cases {
			if (c.Result == "fail" || c.Result == "error") && hasID(c.IDs, id) {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return coded("P2-01", "no fail-first case for %s", id)
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func RequirePass(report model.Report, specs []contracts.Item) error {
	tags := map[string]string{}
	for _, s := range specs {
		tags[s.ID] = s.Tag
	}
	for _, c := range report.Cases {
		if c.Result != "fail" && c.Result != "error" {
			continue
		}
		for _, id := range c.IDs {
			tag, ok := tags[id]
			if ok && !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(tag), "quarantine") {
				return coded("E01", "failed case %q for %s", c.Name, id)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func localDoctorFixture(t *testing.T) doctorFixture {
	t.Helper()
	f := doctorFixture{t: t, root: t.TempDir(), log: filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "probes.log")}
	f.bin = filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fake-fireweed")
	if err := os.WriteFile(f.bin, []byte(`#!/bin/sh
if test "$1" != modules || test "$2" != --json; then exit 2; fi
printf '{"data":['
first=1
find packages -name SPEC.md | while IFS= read -r spec; do
  dir=${spec%/SPEC.md}; name=$(sed -n 's/^name: //p' "$spec" | head -1)
  if test "$first" = 0; then printf ','; fi; first=0
  printf '{"name":"%s","dir":"%s","depends_on":[],"zones":{"interface":["api.txt"],"evals":["evals/**"],"disposable":["internal/**"]}}' "$name" "$dir"
done
printf ']}'
`), 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	recipe := assets.Recipe{ModuleDefaults: structZones(), Hooks: map[string]any{
		"eval":       "sh .fireweed/eval.sh {module} {module_dir} {report}",
		"boundaries": "sh .fireweed/boundary.sh",
		"setup":      "sh .fireweed/setup.sh",
	}}
	f.put("fireweed.yaml", doctorConfig(t, recipe))
	f.put(".gitignore", ".fireweed/runs/\n")
	f.put("AGENTS.md", doctorGuidance)
	f.put("packages/alpha/SPEC.md", "---\nname: alpha\nid_prefix: ALP\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# Alpha\n\n## Specs\n\n### ALP-001\nThe fixture MUST pass.\n")
	f.put("packages/alpha/api.txt", "public\n")
	f.put(".fireweed/templates/module/SPEC.md", "---\nname: {{name}}\nid_prefix: {{prefix}}\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# {{name}}\n\n## Specs\n\n### {{prefix}}-001\nThe canary MUST pass.\n")
	f.put(".fireweed/templates/module/api.txt.tmpl", "{{package}} {{go_module}} {{module_dir}} {{other_dir}}\n")
	f.put(".fireweed/canaries/canaries.yaml", `version: 1
baseline:
  SPEC.md: "---\nname: {{name}}\nid_prefix: {{prefix}}\ndepends_on: []\n---\n# {{name}}\n\n## Specs\n\n### {{prefix}}-001\nThe canary MUST pass.\n"
  api.txt: "{{package}} {{go_module}} {{module_dir}} {{other_dir}}"
undeclared:
  undeclared.txt: "{{other_dir}}"
internal_eval:
  internal/private.txt: "private"
  evals/internal.txt: "{{module_dir}}"
failing_eval:
  evals/failing.txt: "{{prefix}}-001"
missing_id:
  evals/missing.txt: "UNMAPPED-999"
`)
	f.put(".fireweed/setup.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'setup:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\n", f.log))
	f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
printf 'eval:%%s:%%s:%%s\n' "$PWD" "$1" "$FIREWEED_BIN" >> %q
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
if test -f "$2/evals/failing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%%s-001"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"; exit 1; fi
if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="UNMAPPED-999"/></testsuite>' > "$3"; exit 0; fi
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, f.log))
	f.put(".fireweed/boundary.sh", fmt.Sprintf(`#!/bin/sh
printf 'boundaries:%%s:%%s\n' "$PWD" "$FIREWEED_BIN" >> %q
find packages -name SPEC.md | while IFS= read -r spec; do
  dir=${spec%%/SPEC.md}; name=$(sed -n 's/^name: //p' "$spec" | head -1)
  if test -f "$dir/undeclared.txt"; then printf '%%s: undeclared import\n' "$name"; fi
  if test -f "$dir/evals/internal.txt"; then printf '%%s: interface violation\n' "$name"; fi
done
`, f.log))
	f.put(".fireweed/wrap.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'wrap:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" >> %q\nexec \"$@\"\n", f.log))
	f.put(".fireweed/agent.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'worker:%%s:%%s:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" \"$1\" \"$2\" >> %q\nprintf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n", f.log))
	f.put(".fireweed/audit.sh", fmt.Sprintf("#!/bin/bash\nprintf 'audit:%%s:%%s\n' \"$PWD\" \"$1\" >> %q\nprintf 'FIREWEED_DOCTOR_OK\\n'\n", f.log))
	return f
}

func structZones() (z contracts.Zones) {
	z.Interface = []string{"api.txt"}
	z.Evals = []string{"evals/**"}
	z.Disposable = []string{"internal/**"}
	return
}

func doctorText(report checks.DoctorReport) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("checks=%+v diagnostics=%+v", report.Checks, report.Diagnostics)
}
func hasDoctorDiagnostic(report checks.DoctorReport, code string, warning bool, terms ...string) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if d.Code != code || d.Warning != warning {
			continue
		}
		ok := true
		for _, s := range terms {
			if !strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(d.Message), strings.ToLower(s)) {
				ok = false
			}
		}
		if ok {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func hasDoctorCheck(report checks.DoctorReport, name string, passed bool) bool {
	for _, c := range report.Checks {
		if strings.Contains(c.Name, name) && c.Passed == passed {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorErrors(report checks.DoctorReport) bool {
	for _, d := range report.Diagnostics {
		if !d.Warning {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func doctorLog(f doctorFixture) string { b, _ := os.ReadFile(f.log); return string(b) }
func worktrees(f doctorFixture) string { return f.git("worktree", "list", "--porcelain") }

func logDoctorCanaryProbes(t *testing.T, f doctorFixture) {
	t.Helper()
	logProbe := fmt.Sprintf(`printf 'probe:%%s\n' "$PWD" >> %q
for marker in undeclared.txt internal.txt failing.txt missing.txt; do
  if find packages -name "$marker" | grep -q .; then printf 'planted:%%s\n' "$marker" >> %q; fi
if test -f .fireweed/recovery-seen && ! find packages -name undeclared.txt | grep -q .; then printf '%%s: lingering violation\n' "$(cat .fireweed/recovery-seen)"; fi
`))
	g.commit()
	r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), g.request(true))
	if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C14", false, "recovery", "undeclared", "boundar") {
		t.Errorf("missing failed recovery diagnostic: %s", doctorText(r))
	}
}

func Test_CHK_055_CHK_058_CHK_059_EvalEvidenceIsSpecific(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, script, canary string }{
		{"missing baseline coverage", `#!/bin/sh
printf '<testsuite/>' > "$3"
`, "baseline"},
		{"failing eval compile error without report", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/failing.txt"; then echo 'compile error' >&2; exit 2; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"failing eval with unrelated failure", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/failing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="ALP-001"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' > "$3"; exit 1; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "failing_eval"},
		{"missing id with unrelated failure", `#!/bin/sh
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"><failure/></testcase></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"; exit 1; fi
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "missing_id"},
		{"missing id without report", `#!/bin/sh
if test -f "$2/evals/missing.txt"; then echo 'hook failed' >&2; exit 2; fi
prefix=$(sed -n 's/^id_prefix: //p' "$2/SPEC.md" | head -1)
printf '<testsuite><testcase name="%s-001"/></testsuite>' "$prefix" > "$3"
`, "missing_id"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			f.put(".fireweed/eval.sh", tc.script)
			if tc.name == "missing baseline coverage" {
				logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
			}
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C14", false, tc.canary, "eval") {
				t.Errorf("unrelated eval outcome accepted: %s", doctorText(r))
			}
			if tc.name == "missing baseline coverage" && !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "probe:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline coverage hook did not run: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
			if tc.name == "missing baseline coverage" && strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline coverage continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
		})
	}
}

func Test_CHK_055_BaselineAndRecoveryFailures(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct{ name, path, script, phase, hook string }{
		{"baseline eval failure", ".fireweed/eval.sh", "#!/bin/sh\necho baseline-eval-failed >&2\nexit 9\n", "baseline", "eval"},
		{"baseline boundary failure", ".fireweed/boundary.sh", "#!/bin/sh\nprintf 'alpha: baseline violation\\n'\n", "baseline", "boundar"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := localDoctorFixture(t)
			f.put(tc.path, tc.script)
			logDoctorCanaryProbes(t, f)
			f.commit()
			r := checks.Doctor(context.Background(), f.request(true))
			if !hasDoctorDiagnostic(r, "C14", false, tc.phase, tc.hook) {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline accepted: %s", doctorText(r))
			}
			if !strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "probe:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline hook did not run: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
			if strings.Contains(doctorLog(f), "planted:") {
				t.Errorf("failed baseline continued into canary probes: %s", doctorLog(f))
			}
		})

func isInternalEvalViolation(message string, files map[string]string, values map[string]string) bool {
	lower := strings.ToLower(message)
	if !strings.Contains(lower, "interface") {
		return false
	}
	if strings.Contains(lower, "violation") {
		return true
	}
	// Some boundary hooks describe the forbidden import without using the
	// word "violation". Require the diagnostic to identify a planted file.
	for path := range files {
		if strings.Contains(message, filepath.ToSlash(path)) ||
			strings.Contains(message, renderValues(filepath.ToSlash(path), values)) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

var canaryTestName = regexp.MustCompile(`\bTest_[A-Za-z0-9_]+\b`)

func mentionsSuppliedUnknown(message string, files map[string]string, values map[string]string, items []contracts.Item) bool {
	for _, body := range files {
		rendered := renderValues(body, values)
		tokens := append(specLike.FindAllString(rendered, -1), canaryTestName.FindAllString(rendered, -1)...)
		for _, token := range tokens {
			known := false
			for _, item := range items {
				if strings.EqualFold(token, item.ID) {
					known = true
					break
				}
			}
			if !known && strings.Contains(message, token) {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
